title: RSA PKCS#1 v1.5 SHA-256 sign
summary: Sign a message with a 2048-bit RSA private key, PKCS#1 v1.5 padding and SHA-256, and return the 256-byte signature.
notes: Each operation is one 2048-bit RSA private-key operation (two 1024-bit exponentiations where the library uses the CRT) plus SHA-256 of a message of at most 8 KiB, so the load is far smaller than in the fast string tasks.
